input.productDescription: Event page for a three-day outdoor music festival in late summer: about forty artists across three stages. The single page announces dates and location, the lineup by day, ticket tiers with prices, how to get there and where to stay, and answers to common questions. The main goal is to sell tickets before they run out (scarcity is real: tiers sell out). No photography is available, so identity must come from typography, color, layout and bespoke CSS/SVG graphics.
audience: music fans aged 18-40 deciding whether and which ticket to buy
friend groups coordinating a trip together on phones
travellers and campers who need transport and lodging logistics
parents/first-timers who need practical answers (age policy, refunds, accessibility)
primaryTasks: browse the lineup by day and by stage
compare ticket tiers and prices and start checkout
work out how to get there and where to sleep
find answers to common questions before buying
avoid: stock photography or external image URLs
neon purple-to-pink gradient on black festival cliche
decorative effects that hurt legibility of lineup and prices
constraints: Vite + React + plain CSS only; no UI kit, component library or Tailwind
single responsive page, phone-first and desktop
no external image URLs; graphics must be inline SVG/CSS
